title: Syrian Pilaf with Almond Crunch
description: A flavorful Middle Eastern-inspired pilaf dish with crispy almond topping, perfect for a satisfying dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add Syrian pilaf mix and cook according to package instructions.
Stir in 1 cup of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
While pilaf is cooking, toast sliced almonds in a separate pan over medium heat until lightly browned.
Fluff pilaf with a fork and stir in toasted almonds, salt, and black pepper.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
If using quinoa, cook according to package instructions and serve alongside pilaf.
